title: Integrate qualified e-graph normalization

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 qualified e-graph-normalization capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current accelerator head already contains ProgramRepairSynthesizer@1's versioned equality-saturation path: typed e-classes, reviewed rules and side conditions, finite depth/node bounds, canonical equality-rewrite receipts, cheapest-representative extraction, replay, independent effect/equivalence checks, and explicit unavailable-feature reporting. ArchitectureIR, ArchitectureGraphBuilder, and DuplicateAuthorityDetector are also current reusable PCAR prerequisites. The exact source forest does not contain the PCAR-009-owned architecture_refactorer/egraph_normalizer.py or its dedicated test, nor an adapter that binds the program-repair equality domain to PCAR-009's reviewed architecture-refactorer domains and multi-objective extractor. The declared-output authority permits only this receipt, so no duplicate normalizer, unsafe adapter, source-map authority, or test alteration was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: Although a narrow deterministic equality-rewrite probe and the required sealed PCSM suite pass, the focused current-head e-graph suite has two failing tests: replay leaves one duplicate redex unreduced, and saturation fails to e-match a newly inserted e-node. These failures invalidate qualification of the reusable path for PCSM-067. In addition, the PCAR-009 module/test, architecture-domain rule catalog, rule-specific proof/translation vectors, multi-objective extraction contract, and canonical aggregate PCSM source-map CID are absent. This receipt records a typed honest non-promotion rather than manufacture an integration, proof, CID, passing validation, or promotion claim.

equality_saturation.role: A typed e-graph that accepts only a declared reviewed equality theory; it constrains theory/rule sizes, rewrite depth, e-graph nodes, replay steps, and text sizes; restores congruence by rebuild; rejects unsafe sorts, effects, authority claims, unreviewed side conditions, and malformed terms; derives canonical content identities; and keeps every equality receipt proposal-only with no write or semantic authority.

architecture_refactorer_prerequisites.role: Existing deterministic, provenance-bound graph and duplicate-authority analysis prerequisites. They do not define PCAR-009's closed e-graph expression domains, approved rewrite catalog, rule-evidence dispositions, or multi-objective extractor.

integration_status.reason: The current forest has no architecture_refactorer/egraph_normalizer.py, test_egraph_normalizer.py, PCAR-009 rule catalog, PCAR-009 saturation receipt, or adapter from the program-repair equality grammar to architecture-refactorer operation/effect/policy/result/schema/dependency/validation expressions. The reusable equality path therefore cannot honestly be presented as PCSM-067 integration.

determinism_and_authority_boundary.binding: DeclaredEqualityTheory and EqualityRule require reviewed theory/rule identities; EqualityRewriteReceipt@1 canonically binds the theory, terms, status, applied rules, bounds-derived measurements, replay steps, checks, and capability inventory. A sealed repeated reviewed add-zero probe yielded the identical receipt CID baguqeeratoqyg7edqd7rabk4suabtzksseoucizvwm5fy6qqeitlk5hthkmq twice. Bounded saturation and extraction are deterministic for the covered narrow case.
determinism_and_authority_boundary.boundary: The equality path emits proposal-only results and rejects write/semantic-authority claims. It neither selects a canonical architecture authority, mutates M2/M3 state, fabricates a PCSM source map, converts a heuristic into proof, nor treats model output, a candidate, a test, or runtime transport success as completion or promotion authority. The two current e-graph regressions prevent broader qualification.
